# SpectraWave

> A free, client-side toolkit for spectroscopy and photonics researchers: converts wavelength (nm), photon energy (eV, J), wavenumber (cm⁻¹), and frequency (THz), and plots multiple absorption spectra with waterfall offsets, a colorblind-safe palette, and publication-ready SVG/PNG export. Everything runs in the browser; no data is transmitted, no account required.

## Key formulas

- Energy (eV) = 1239.84198 / Wavelength (nm)
- Wavenumber (cm⁻¹) = 10,000,000 / Wavelength (nm)
- Frequency (THz) = 299792.458 / Wavelength (nm)
- Wavelength (nm) = 1239.84198 / Energy (eV)

## Reference values for common lasers

| Laser | Wavelength (nm) | Energy (eV) | Wavenumber (cm⁻¹) | Frequency (THz) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ArF Excimer | 193 | 6.424 | 51813 | 1553.3 |
| KrF Excimer | 248 | 4.999 | 40323 | 1208.8 |
| XeCl Excimer | 308 | 4.025 | 32468 | 973.4 |
| Nd:YAG 3rd Harmonic | 355 | 3.493 | 28169 | 844.5 |
| Diode (violet/Blu-ray) | 405 | 3.061 | 24691 | 740.2 |
| Argon-Ion (blue) | 488 | 2.541 | 20492 | 614.3 |
| Nd:YAG 2nd Harmonic (green) | 532 | 2.331 | 18797 | 563.5 |
| Helium-Neon (HeNe) | 632.8 | 1.959 | 15803 | 473.8 |
| Ruby | 694.3 | 1.786 | 14403 | 431.8 |
| Ti:Sapphire (center) | 800 | 1.550 | 12500 | 374.7 |
| Nd:YAG (fundamental) | 1064 | 1.165 | 9398.5 | 281.8 |
| Telecom InGaAsP (C-band) | 1550 | 0.800 | 6451.6 | 193.4 |
| Er:YAG | 2940 | 0.422 | 3401.4 | 102.0 |
| CO2 | 10600 | 0.117 | 943.4 | 28.3 |

## Absorption spectrum viewer

A client-side, multi-trace spectrum plotter with paired wavelength/energy axes (selectable nm, eV, or cm⁻¹):

- Load multiple spectra and overlay them, or give each an independent Y offset to stack them waterfall-style.
- Load data via the built-in illustrative example (fluorescein), CSV upload, or pasting two columns copied straight from a spreadsheet.
- New spectra are auto-assigned colors from the colorblind-safe Okabe-Ito palette, overridable per trace with a color picker.
- Customizable chart title, per-trace legend labels, X/Y axis min/max/tick step, background color (transparent/white/theme/custom), and an optional closed axis box (top/right border + mirrored ticks) matching the GraphPad Prism convention.
- Export the chart as a vector SVG (for Illustrator/Inkscape) or PNG, and export each spectrum's underlying data as CSV converted to nm, eV, or cm⁻¹.

No account or upload to a server is required for any of this.

## Pages

- [Converter, spectrum viewer, and reference tables](https://spectrawave.vercel.app/): interactive calculator, multi-spectrum absorption plotter, full laser reference table, and an educational guide explaining the wavelength-to-energy relationship, why energy scales nonlinearly with wavelength, and how to build a publication-ready spectrum figure.
